durable-task-scheduler-ha-needs-three-cu.title: Production Durable Task Scheduler needs 3 Capacity Units for high availability
durable-task-scheduler-ha-needs-three-cu.body: A single-CU Dedicated scheduler gives no redundancy. Microsoft says high availability requires 3 Capacity Units per scheduler; this estimate has fewer, so raising it to 3 CUs per scheduler increases the hourly charge.

citation.quote: For high-availability deployments, configure three CUs. Single-CU deployments don't provide redundancy.

durable-task-scheduler-consumption-no-ha.title: The Consumption SKU has no high availability
durable-task-scheduler-consumption-no-ha.body: This production estimate uses the Consumption SKU. Microsoft lists high availability as not available for Consumption (it needs the Dedicated SKU with 3 Capacity Units per scheduler), so consider Dedicated for production workloads that must stay up.

citation.quote: High availability Supported (requires 3 CUs) Not available
